With consistent use along with the TBT cream and tbt eye cream, I bemeine this serum really helps! I will be buying again. It is light and doesn't clog my pores either.

This is my second bottle. It doesn't irritate my skin. I'm not sure how much change I've noticed, but I feel like my skin looks good and it makes me feel good knowing it's a clean product.

avis.titre: My skin has never looked better
avis.texte: I've been using this product along with a few others from Dime and I absolutely love what it has done for my skin! It has my skin looking 10 years younger and I don't wear cover up anymore because my skin feels natural and healthy!
Haven't seen much of a difference and I've been using it for a few weeks. I will continue to use it in hopes to see more of a change.
I love this serum. It really makes my skin look brighter and plumper, especially my forehead where I have a big wrinkle line. I have been getting lots of comments about how great my skin is looking.
This serum feels amazing going on, soaks in well and makes such a difference in my skin texture.
Noticed a difference after only a few days. Highly recommend!
I love the scent of the products and this serum. My skin is so sensitive and I have never broke out with this!

avis.titre: Always apart of my skincare routine
avis.texte: Dime has become a staple in my skincare routine over the past two years !! It's clean , light, absorbs well into my skin and has made a huge difference in this almost 60yr old skin … Thanks Dime Beauty

I've tried a few products by this brand, and this is the only one I really care for. It works welll as an exfoliant, but it's gentle and not extremely drying. It does slough the skin, but not in a way that leaves you feeling rought or dry.

I bought this on sale because I needed to replace my a.m. niacinimide serum, and it had such great reviews, I thought it must be good. Unfortunately, I have to agree with some of the other negative reviews. It is so thin, it makes it difficult to put on. Also, it feels like I'm putting alcohol on my skin because it dries immediately. It is not at all "silky," as one review wrote. And most disappointingly, it's not moisturizing in the least. I will be going back to my old serum as soon as possible, probably before this bottle is even empty.

Since the product is a serum, I expected it to be thicker and easier to apply. The directions say to apply 3 to 5 drops. It is so watery that I lose a lot of of the product because it drips out of the dropper into the sink or goes right through my fingers when I go to put it on. I've only been using it a couple weeks, but I do think it is helping to reduce the fine lines on my forehead. All in all the jury is still out on its effectiveness. It's hard to believe it can do a lot of good being so thin and watery that I can't spread it around.
I had an insane reaction to this. My skin was so red and burning I had to put a fan on my face after I washed it off
This serum is actually so amazing. I will always recommend this to everyone 💕
I bought this looking for a new serum with Mandelic acid. I didn't have any negatives but also feel like it didn't really do anything, especially for the price. I won't be buying again.

Alright. I have beef with this product. To be fair, i only used it once and not properly, so im sure its amazing for those who use it properly. However, im very annoyed because nowhere did it say this is an exfoliating serum until i looked it up. I already exfoliated my skin and then was excited to try my new serum that has amazing reviews, and then my skin got red and irritated. I dont have sensitive skin so i was curious why it was bothering me. Then i looked it up and saw its an exfoliating product. This is advertised as a serum with no clear indicators that its exoliating which i find very misleading. Please fix the packaging or name it "exfoliating sefum" becaude i think what i did was an easy mistake to make.
My skin is GLOWING. Even my husband has noticed. I have definitely noticed a big improvement in my skin texture and all over brightness. I'm obsessed.
A must have for every girls beauty girl's beauty and skin routine. I can definitely see visible changes in my skin and I love how my face feels after use. Definitely ordering again!!!
It's such a refreshing serum and I have really noticed a difference in the tone of my skin.
I noticed a difference within a couple weeks with this cream. The lines on my forehead and around my eyes were noticeably less. Will be ordering this again and again!
I needed something for my fine lines and so glad I found this serum! Would definitely recommend.
I love the clean ingredients and the way my face feels after I use the products.
So thankful to have found a clean retinol that helps my aging skin!
I love this product!! It goes on so smooth and soaks into my skin so well. I have definitely noticed a difference.

I use this with my nighttime routine. It's not oily going on and my skin feels hydrated the next day.
I'm using this product for more than 6 months I don't see any difference in my skin

Dare I say, that I like the tbt serum even more than the cream? As a woman who is now closer to 40 than 30, my skin has shifted plenty in the past 6 years and required support. Tbt serum is a fav that I don't see myself removing from my regime any time soon! If we could work on the cost of shipping to Canada, that would be wonderful. Sometimes I would be able to purchase double the skin care with that cost!
I love the way this oil makes my skin feel refreshed without being greasy.
I purchased this because I was looking for a mandelic serum that was a little less pricey than Sofie pavitt. this one does the job! my skin feels great. I'll be repurchasing.

Letting is soak in and then using additional products including the TBT cream. I have sensitive skin and this feels great and has improved my overall skin.

I've used this with a combination of other DIME products. It is a must in my skin care routine. Makes skin look firmer and just look for youthful all together. I use this at night. Once it's dry and set for about 10 minutes I will use the TBT cream for over night moisture.
After using the serum for about 4 wks, my dark spots were totally gone. My wrinkles are not as prominent either. I use this daily with my other Dime products now! Love it!
I absolutely love the serum!!! I truly love all of the Dime products. I've been a dedicated user since their start. Ive gotten compliments on my skin ( Im 58) from facialists so I know its working!
